title: The link type of pcap determines what header the starting point of the packet is.
summary: The traditional pcap global header records LinkType, and the packet data does not necessarily start from the Ethernet frame header.
applies: Legacy libpcap format; single interface capture
detail: The packet layout of Linux cooked capture or raw IP is different from Ethernet, fixed skipping 14 bytes may miss the IP header.
boundary: Ethernet frames may also contain VLAN tags internally; even if the link type is Ethernet, the actual header must be interpreted.
relevance: The file byte offset of the same IP packet on different collection interfaces may be different.
